Telos plugin privacy policy

Policy

Telos's plugin runs on your computer. The publisher operates no backend, account or inference service for it, and the plugin collects no telemetry or usage statistics.

What it reads. Files inside its own package, fixture data shipped with it, and, for the room and workflow tools, sibling tool checkouts next to the package when they exist.

What it stores. Nothing that outlives a call. The workflow check writes scratch files in a temporary folder and removes them before it returns.

What it runs. Each tool starts a local Node.js script from the package with fixed arguments. The room and workflow tools also start a local Python interpreter against sibling checkouts. No tool on the packaged server writes to your files, opens a network connection or drives a browser or application.

Retention. None.

Third parties. The connected client and its model see tool arguments and results under that client's terms. Your model provider's privacy policy applies to what the model reads.

Support and security reports. https://github.com/HarperZ9/telos/issues

Source

This policy comes from client-plugin/PRIVACY.md in the Telos repository.
